incoming.name: Portugal
incoming.excerpt: The most important airports are in Lisbon, Faro ( Algarve), Oporto, Funchal ( Madeira), and Ponta Delgada ( Azores).

outgoing.name: 16th century
outgoing.excerpt: In the 16th century Funchal was important as a stopping place between the Indies and the New World, and was known as a wealthy place.

outgoing.name: Fennel
outgoing.excerpt: The city is named after fennel, ('funcho' in Portuguese), which grows in abundance on the island.

outgoing.name: Portugal
outgoing.excerpt: IPA [fũ'ʃaɫ]), population approximately 140,000, is the capital of the Madeira Islands of Portugal.

outgoing.name: Postage stamp
outgoing.excerpt: Between 1892 and 1905, Portugal issued postage stamps inscribed "Funchal", but then reverted to the stamps of Madeira.

outgoing.name: Sugar
outgoing.excerpt: It was also the port for Madeiran sugar and wine.
